first_useful_action.note: Found CIB-398 amendment: graph-context tools refuse nested workspaceRoot.

answer: No for a nested directory as workspaceRoot on the six GCTX tools. plans/decisions/125-mcp-admits-linked-worktrees.md (ADR-125) was amended 2026-09-03 (CIB-398): daemon-keyed graph-context tools require workspaceRoot to be exactly the server cwd or a registered linked Git worktree root — not a directory inside either. docs/guides/ai-context-delivery.md states the same graph-root rule: a subdirectory is refused because the daemon keys its graph on that root and reports workspace-relative paths, so a nested root would rebase a sensitive path such as secrets/token.ts to token.ts past the CE-3 sensitive-path filter (identity/privacy invariant). Ordinary check/gate/write tools still admit containment under cwd or registered worktrees; the nested refusal is specific to GCTX. Blast radius for changing this: MCP GCTX tool admission (validate_gctx_workspace_root), the guide, public MCP docs, and ADR-125. Keep anvil_validate_write on any edit; this V1 session used search/read only.
